Swar uses FFmpeg 9.0.2, licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License
version 2.1 or later. Copyright (c) the FFmpeg developers.

The unmodified source archive, complete license, and build configuration accompany
this application as FFmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz, FFmpeg-LGPL.txt, FFmpeg-LICENSE.md, and
FFmpeg-Build.txt. The upstream source is also available at:
https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz

Swar dynamically loads libavformat, libavcodec, libavutil, and libswresample from
Contents/Frameworks. This build disables GPL and nonfree components, network I/O,
programs, encoders, video decoders, and external libraries. libswresample is an
internal dependency of FFmpeg's Opus decoder; Swar does not use it to change PCM
sample rates. Library install names are adjusted for app-local loading; no FFmpeg
source code is modified.

The build recipe is Tools/build_codecs.py in the Swar source tree. Library
replacement requires compatible major ABIs and local re-signing of the application
and replacement libraries under macOS code-signing rules. FFmpeg authors provide
no warranty; see the accompanying license text.
